standard_prerequisites: More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-henselization-Noetherian-pair: the henselization of a finite type algebra over a Noetherian ring with respect to an ideal is Noetherian
More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-henselization (construction): the henselization is a filtered colimit of etale C-algebras C-prime with C/IC isomorphic to C-prime/IC-prime
Standard henselization fact recorded by the author: such etale extensions have the same henselization and the same completion as the pair (C, IC)
core_obligations: Write the ideal J of the Noetherian henselization with finitely many generators g_1 ... g_m
Choose an etale C-algebra C-prime in the filtered system whose mod IC reduction is trivial and which contains preimages g-prime_1 ... g-prime_m of the generators
Set B = C-prime modulo the ideal generated by the preimages; B is a finite type A-algebra
Since (C, IC) and (C-prime, IC-prime) have the same completion, and completion is exact on the finitely generated quotients, the completion of B identifies with the completion of C-h modulo J
proof_roadmap: Descend the generators of the ideal into an etale approximation
Transport the completion isomorphism through the quotient
